name: btxdoc required-field table (Patashnik, BibTeXing 1988, sec. 3.1): article needs journal, book author or editor, inbook chapter or pages, techreport institution, unpublished note

name: parse: @string macro joined with #, month macro, nested braces, quoted value, bare number

  author = {Smith, John and M{\"u}ller, Hans},

all operations: duplicate removed, keys renamed, check after
